data: Which of these represents the negative sample ratio in training where the performance of the NN model (with GloVe embedding) on the dev set is the highest?

The question asks which negative sample ratio in training results in the highest performance of the NN model on the dev set. From the caption, we know that the performance is measured in terms of Micro-average F1 (%). The figure shows two lines representing the performance on the dev set (red line) and test set (blue line), both plotted against the negative sample ratio in training. 

By examining the red line, which corresponds to the dev set performance, we can see that it peaks at approximately 30% around a negative sample ratio of 8.0. This indicates that the highest performance on the dev set occurs at this point. Therefore, the answer is 8.0.
